scope: Supervised physical pickup of the upright yellow cylinder on the bench; wrist-camera visual servoing plus provisional SDK FK. Not a calibrated or autonomous grasp controller.

right_arm.result: grasped, lifted ~6 cm clear of the table, held upright, lowered, released and returned to verified rest; cylinder left standing
right_arm.then: grip -2.5 (SDK caps closing, regulates to 0.5 Nm on contact); IK nudge +3 cm z twice at pitch -15
earlier_attempts: slow step-and-look approach (~10 min) reached the grasp pose but tripped the 48 C elbow guard before closing
second attempt closed in steps but tripped the 52 C guard before lifting; gripper speed guard false-tripped on capped closing (fixed: gripper excluded)

left_arm.result: missed: jaws closed above the cylinder top; cylinder untouched; verified rest/release
left_arm.notes: Different claw type and different joint offsets from the right arm: the same model tip height sits roughly 10 cm higher physically than on the right. Needs its own height reference (side camera) before closing. Shoulder hit 52 C in the deeper pose (6-7 Nm).

learnings: Skip full camera-to-arm calibration for a single object: pan to centre it between the jaws in the wrist camera, advance along the approach axis, judge height from the laptop side view.
SDK FK frame: x forward, y left, z up; +pan turns the arm to its right. At rest the upper arm folds backward, so forward reach swings the shoulder ~90-120 degrees.
Model z does not match the table: right fingertips were at mid-cylinder with model tip z ~0.16 m; left was above the cylinder at 0.10 m. Use cameras, not model height.

Thermal budget is the limiting factor: shoulder/elbow carry 4.5-7 Nm while extended and heat ~1.5 C/min; slow step-and-look approaches overheat, replaying measured waypoints at 12-15 deg/s finishes in under 20 s.
Torque guard must compare to the gravity model and wait out the SDK's 0.5 s gravity ease-in; gripper velocity spikes during capped closing and must not be speed-guarded.
Repeated hold freezes let the arm creep upward several cm; send fresh targets instead of relying on repeated freezes.
dream_api_key: Not on this Mac. Scripts reference 1Password item via DREAM_API_KEY (see DreamSim/start_worker.command); no op CLI or Agents Vault helper installed here.
